Find [[Shalev the Hermit]] in [[Old Ascalon]].

==Quest Information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = elementalist
}}

===Objectives===
* Seek out [[Shalev the Hermit]].

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 {{gold}} ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Armor of Earth}}
* {{skill icon|Frozen Burst}}

==Walkthrough==
* Find Shalev in [[Old Ascalon]]. The shortest way is to start from [[Sardelac Sanitarium]]. When you arrive, sometimes Shalev will be attacked by some Devourers around there. Kill the devourers and talk to Shalev for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Elementalist Aziure
:''"You seek knowledge of the elements? I fear your own learning has outstripped my ability to aid you. Still, there may be a way for you to obtain the knowledge you seek. One of the most knowlegeable of our number, a man named '''Shalev''', has forsaken all human contact. He resides now as a hermit in what used to be '''[[Green Hills County]]'''. Seek out the cave of Shalev. He can grant you the knowledge you seek."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will seek him out.
| decline = Perhaps some other time.
| ask = Find '''Shalev the Hermit'''. He resides in a cave what used to be Green Hills County.
}}

===Reward Dialogue===
;Shalev the Hermit
:''"You are here seeking knowledge of the elements. Shalev knows of you, '''<Character name>'''. You would save Ascalon from the tragedy that has befallen her? Then you will need the knowledge that Shalev has to offer. A taste of this knowledge Shalev will give to you and more if you will perform a task for him."''
